Exam Date & Time: 21-Dec-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  INTRODUCTION TO COMMNUNICATION SYSTEMS [ECE_4313]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Give any three examples of industrial domains where 5G-enabled IIoT can be applied effectively.        (5)  
  Why is low latency important for IIoT applications like robotics and process automation in 5G  
  A)           networks?  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"

  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)           Interpret the importance of bandwidth in determining the quality of video streaming services.          (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2)                Differentiate between semiconductor Light Emitting Diode (LED) and laser diode as optical sources (5)  
  in terms of power and application.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Use the concept of a link power budget to determine feasibility for a 10 km optical fiber link.        (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Apply the concept of PIN vs. Avalanche Photodiode (APD) detectors in designing high-speed              (2)  
  optical communication links.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3)                Compare the functions of satellite subsystems (power vs. communication vs. control) in practical       (5)  
  use.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Apply satellite applications to explain how GPS supports military navigation.                          (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Compare virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) in terms of user experience and                (2)  
  application.

  A)

  urban networks.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"

  environments.
